depending on what you consider a playstyle, there's many, many types: 

poison is my favorite personally, and it usually features gdoll, nymphaea, xu, lily  (or aurita+faros), and sustains. Poison teams like having someone to apply poison, and someone to trigger it, along with survivability for it to stack up

counter is pretty similar too, and often features caecus/nautila/tawil/wanda etc. These teams like having a LOT of shield, so characters like pontos help here. Permanent counter is also beneficial, which caecus is the best character for iirc

outside of status effects, there's teams which are built around a certain dps, and characters that emphasize their traits: lemurians falls here (it's a tentacle team featuring Gmurphy, and characters that boost her talent effect), as do strike-focused teams (primarily with mouchette or Glotan, though ghelot also counts for this), and sanga overexalt (she deals damage based on how much shield you have, and scales pretty well), and even discard comps which feature characters like corpossant and aurita, that discard and draw really often for various effects

outside that you'll have plenty of teams where the gimmick is just vulnerable+strong dps, sometimes with nice sustain to stall and scale, or corrosion to amp up your bursts , like castor-pollux-horla, or dps kath which likes to stall, or 24 chaos, which stalls a lot to build up her damage scaling etcc

ultimately, there's a LOT of characters, and pretty much all of them have some place or the other. Most dps feel quite different to play from each other as well, so you might consider teams that spam posse like vortice different from teams that spam cards or exalt or strength etc
